title: 3 密林激战4 溃兵截道
content_zh:
土黄色的矮脚马冲出去，朝着与那片草丛相反的方向狂奔。
“追！”
外委把总的声音在身后炸开：“别让他跑了！”
“咚咚咚！咚咚咚！！”
急促的马蹄声如雷。
曹笔伏在马背上，回头看了一眼，心思开始流转。
追出来的骑兵有十五六个，都比他这个刚学会骑马的人骑得好，但没关系。
他不需要比他们骑得好，他只需要比他们先到那片山林。
前方，山林的轮廓越来越清晰。
三百米。
两百米。
一百米。
身后传来弓弦崩响的声音，曹笔本能地一缩脖子，一支箭擦着他头皮飞过去，钉在前面的树上。
他伏得更低，整个人几乎贴在马背上。
又是两箭，一箭从他耳边呼啸而过，一箭射中马屁股旁边的空气。
曹笔的心脏狂跳，祈祷自己和马不要被射中。
五十米。
三十米。
十米。
马蹄踏入林缘的瞬间，曹笔翻身下马，落地一个翻滚，顺势站起来，一头扎进林子深处。

那匹土黄色的矮脚马继续往前冲了几步，被树枝拦住，停下来，茫然地甩着尾巴。
追兵在林缘勒住马。
“下马！”
外委把总的声音响起：“他进了林子，跑不远！伍长在前，什长垫后，两人一组，给我搜！”
十几个人跳下马，拔出刀，分成六七组，纷纷钻进林子。
一刻钟后，密林深处。
曹笔屏住呼吸，藏在一棵爬满藤蔓的大树后面，一动不动地感受着越来越近的脚步声。
“噗嗤！”
电光火石之间，他突然暴起，一刀将刚露面的一个伍长给割了喉。
“你找死！！”
伍长后面三步，一直保持着警惕的什长见状，大怒，提刀便砍！
曹笔侧身躲过，顺手夺过已经死亡的伍长的缺口砍刀，反手一撩，后发先至，一刀断臂。
什长甚至还未感觉到疼痛，持刀的手臂就已经离他而去。
他大骇！
“噗嗤！”
不待他进一步动作，反撩的断臂刀，一个变向横斩，直接抹了他的脖子。
他本能地捂住犹如喷泉一般，疯狂喷洒鲜血的脖子，眼神极其难以置信地盯着曹笔，似乎想说什么。
content_en:
The khaki pony rushed out and ran in the opposite direction to the grass.
"Chase!"
The foreign affairs committee member blasted the president's voice behind him: "Don't let him run away!"
"Dong Dong Dong! Dong Dong Dong!!"
The sound of rapid horse hooves is like thunder.
Cao Bi leaned on the horse, looked back, and his thoughts began to flow.
There were fifteen or six cavalrymen chasing him, and they were all better than him, who had just learned to ride, but it didn't matter.
He didn't need to ride better than them, he just needed to get to the forest before them.
Ahead, the outline of the mountain forest becomes increasingly clear.
Three hundred meters.
Two hundred meters.
One hundred meters.
There was the sound of a bow string crashing behind him. Cao Bi instinctively shrank his neck, and an arrow flew past his scalp and was nailed to the tree in front of him.
He lowered himself even lower, almost pressing against the horse's back.
Two more arrows were fired, one whizzing by his ear and one hitting the air next to the horse's butt.
Cao Bi's heart was beating wildly, praying that he and his horse would not be shot.
Fifty meters.
Thirty meters.
Ten meters.
The moment the horse's hooves stepped into the edge of the forest, Cao Bi dismounted, rolled on the ground, stood up, and plunged into the depths of the forest.
The khaki pony continued to charge forward a few steps, but was stopped by a branch and stopped, waving its tail in confusion.
The pursuers reined in their horses at the edge of the forest.
"Dismount!"
The Foreign Affairs Committee raised the voice of the general manager: "He entered the forest and can't run far! The corps commander is in front, and the chief is behind, in pairs, search for me!"
More than a dozen people jumped off their horses, drew their swords, divided into six or seven groups, and went into the forest one after another.
A quarter of an hour later, deep in the dense forest.
Cao Bi held his breath and hid behind a large tree covered with vines, motionless as he felt the approaching footsteps.
"Pfft!"
In the flash of lightning, he suddenly burst into flames and slashed the throat of a corps commander who had just appeared.
"You are looking for death!!"
Three steps behind the corps commander, Shi Chang, who had always been vigilant, saw this and became furious, so he raised his knife and slashed!
Cao Bi dodged sideways, grabbed the notched machete of the dead team leader, flipped it back with his backhand, and cut off his arm with the knife.
Before Shichang even felt the pain, the arm holding the knife had already left him.
He was horrified!
"Pfft!"
Without waiting for him to take any further action, the arm-breaking knife was raised back and slashed horizontally, directly wiping his neck.
He instinctively covered his neck, which was spraying blood like a fountain, and stared at Cao Bi in disbelief, as if he wanted to say something.
